events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their sixth studio album, "Rubber Soul," in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul
angles.copy: More than six decades on, The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' still sounds as fresh and groundbreaking as it did on release. A timeless classic.

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the tragic death of The Beatles icon, John Lennon, in 1980.

angles.name: Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the profound musical legacy of John Lennon, whose influence continues to shape generations.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: The legendary musician and cultural icon David Bowie would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Bowie 80th
angles.copy: Today, we celebrate the enduring artistry and innovation of David Bowie, who would have turned 80. Still influencing music and style.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, would have marked his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: Elvis 92nd
angles.copy: Happy heavenly birthday to the King, Elvis Presley, who would have turned 92 today. His music is forever etched in history.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Led Zeppelin guitarist and rock legend Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Page 83rd
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 83rd birthday to the incomparable Jimmy Page. His riffs defined a generation of rock music.

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Iconic British singer-songwriter Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Stewart 82nd
angles.copy: Happy 82nd birthday to the one and only Rod Stewart. Still rocking after all these years.

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham McPherson, better known as Suggs from Madness, celebrates his 66th birthday today.

angles.name: Suggs 66th
angles.copy: One step beyond and 66 years old! Happy birthday to the legendary Suggs of Madness.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: British singer Paul Young, known for hits like "Wherever I Lay My Hat (That's My Home)," celebrates his 71st birthday.

angles.name: Young 71st
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 71st birthday to the smooth voice of Paul Young. A true 80s icon.

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: The iconic singer, songwriter, and businesswoman Dolly Parton celebrates her 81st birthday today.

angles.name: Parton 81st
angles.copy: Happy 81st birthday to the legendary Dolly Parton! Still working 9 to 5 and inspiring millions.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman and acclaimed songwriter Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday today.

angles.name: Barlow 56th
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 56th birthday to the one and only Gary Barlow. Still going strong with Take That.

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: British R&B singer Billy Ocean, known for global hits like "Caribbean Queen," celebrates his 77th birthday.

angles.name: Ocean 77th
angles.copy: Get out of my dreams, get into my car... and wish Billy Ocean a happy 77th birthday!

events.title: Rock & Roll Hall of Fame Inaugural Ceremony
events.blurb: The first Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony took place in 1989, honouring pioneers like Elvis Presley and The Beatles.

angles.name: RRHOF Inaugural
angles.copy: On this day in 1989, rock history was made with the very first Rock & Roll Hall of Fame induction. Who would be in your dream lineup?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member Mark Owen celebrates his 55th birthday today.

angles.name: Owen 55th
angles.copy: Happy 55th birthday to Mark Owen! Still bringing the pop magic with Take That.

events.title: The Beatles' Rooftop Concert Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles performed their legendary final public performance on the rooftop of Apple Corps in London in 1969.

angles.name: Rooftop Concert
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago today, The Beatles took to the roof for their iconic final live performance. What a way to go out.

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: Grammy-winning singer, drummer, and songwriter Phil Collins celebrates his 76th birthday today.

angles.name: Collins 76th
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 76th birthday to the legendary Phil Collins. Still 'In The Air Tonight' for us.

events.title: Hugh Grant turns 67
events.blurb: Beloved British actor Hugh Grant, known for his roles in romantic comedies, celebrates his 67th birthday.

angles.name: Grant 67th
angles.copy: Happy 67th birthday to the charming Hugh Grant! From rom-com king to national treasure, he's done it all.

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: Pop superstar, actor, and former NSYNC member Justin Timberlake celebrates his 46th birthday.

angles.name: Timberlake 46th
angles.copy: Bringing sexy back for 46 years! Happy birthday to the multi-talented Justin Timberlake.

events.title: David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary British actor Sir David Jason, famous for his roles as Del Boy and Jack Frost, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Jason 87th
angles.copy: Lovely jubbly! Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the national treasure, Sir David Jason.

events.title: The Day The Music Died Anniversary
events.blurb: Today marks the tragic anniversary of the 1959 plane crash that claimed the lives of Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper.

angles.name: Music Died Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper, whose lives were tragically cut short on this day in 1959. Their music lives on.

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: British singer-songwriter Rick Astley, known for his 80s hits and viral comeback, celebrates his 61st birthday.

angles.name: Astley 61st
angles.copy: Never gonna give up on wishing Rick Astley a happy 61st birthday! Still a legend.

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82
events.blurb: The reggae icon Bob Marley would have celebrated his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Marley 82nd
angles.copy: Celebrating the life and legacy of Bob Marley, who would have turned 82 today. His message of peace and love resonates globally.

events.title: Carole King turns 85
events.blurb: Legendary singer-songwriter Carole King, behind countless hits, celebrates her 85th birthday today.

angles.name: King 85th
angles.copy: Happy 85th birthday to the incredible Carole King. A true songwriting genius whose music defines generations.

events.title: Remembering Whitney Houston
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the passing of the iconic vocalist Whitney Houston in 2012.

angles.name: Houston Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled voice and talent of Whitney Houston, gone but never forgotten.

events.title: Take That Split Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, pop sensation Take That announced their split, breaking hearts across the nation.

angles.name: Take That Split
angles.copy: Twenty-nine years ago today, the pop world wept as Take That announced their split. Thankfully, they're back 'for good' now!

events.title: Ali Campbell turns 68
events.blurb: UB40 frontman Ali Campbell celebrates his 68th birthday today.

angles.name: Campbell 68th
angles.copy: Red, Red Wine and 68 years young! Happy birthday to UB40's Ali Campbell.

events.title: Ed Sheeran turns 36
events.blurb: Global superstar Ed Sheeran celebrates his 36th birthday today.

angles.name: Sheeran 36th
angles.copy: Happy 36th birthday to the incredible Ed Sheeran! Still making stadium-filling hits.

events.title: George Harrison would have been 84
events.blurb: The beloved Beatles guitarist George Harrison would have celebrated his 84th birthday today.

angles.name: Harrison 84th
angles.copy: Remembering the quiet Beatle, George Harrison, who would have turned 84 today. His music shines on.

events.title: Roger Daltrey turns 83
events.blurb: The iconic lead singer of The Who, Roger Daltrey, celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Daltrey 83rd
angles.copy: Hope he gets what he wants for his 83rd! Happy birthday to The Who's legendary frontman, Roger Daltrey.

events.title: Nik Kershaw turns 69
events.blurb: British pop singer-songwriter Nik Kershaw, known for his 80s hits, celebrates his 69th birthday.

angles.name: Kershaw 69th
angles.copy: Wouldn't it be good to wish Nik Kershaw a happy 69th birthday? We certainly think so.

events.title: Chris Martin turns 50
events.blurb: Coldplay frontman Chris Martin celebrates his 50th birthday today.

angles.name: Martin 50th
angles.copy: Fifty years young! Happy birthday to Coldplay's Chris Martin, still filling stadiums around the world.

events.title: Jon Bon Jovi turns 65
events.blurb: Bon Jovi lead singer Jon Bon Jovi celebrates his 65th birthday today.

angles.name: BonJovi 65th
angles.copy: Whoa, we're halfway there! Happy 65th birthday to the legendary Jon Bon Jovi.

events.title: Chris Rea would have been 76
events.blurb: The beloved singer-songwriter Chris Rea, known for his distinctive voice and guitar work, would have celebrated his 76th birthday today.

angles.name: Rea 76th
angles.copy: Remembering the smooth sounds of Chris Rea, who would have turned 76 today. His music remains a comfort.

events.title: Mary Wilson would have been 83
events.blurb: The legendary co-founder of The Supremes, Mary Wilson, would have celebrated her 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Wilson 83rd
angles.copy: Remembering the grace and talent of Mary Wilson of The Supremes, who would have turned 83 today. Her legacy shines on.

events.title: Michael Jackson's Moonwalk Debut Anniversary
events.blurb: Michael Jackson famously debuted his iconic Moonwalk dance move during his performance of "Billie Jean" at Motown 25 in 1983.

angles.name: Moonwalk Debut
angles.copy: On this day in 1983, Michael Jackson changed dance forever with the Moonwalk. Still mesmerising decades later.

events.title: Gary Numan turns 69
events.blurb: Pioneer of electronic music Gary Numan celebrates his 69th birthday today.

angles.name: Numan 69th
angles.copy: Are 'Friends' Electric? Gary Numan turns 69 today, still influencing music with his unique sound.
